announcements.headline: Sale of Peyia Land in Cyprus
announcements.insight: Following Venus Rock's sale in August, this disposal of Peyia Land represents a further asset reduction. Shareholders should monitor the remaining portfolio size and cash distribution.

announcements.headline: Directorate change
announcements.insight: DCI Advisors Ltd announces a directorate change. This governance update follows recent asset disposals and escrow releases.

announcements.headline: Completion of the sale of Venus Rock Estates
announcements.insight: DCI completes another asset disposal, following the Apollo land plots sale in June. This continues a pattern of divesting holdings.

announcements.headline: Correction of Announcement Released on 22 July 26
announcements.insight: DCI Advisors Ltd corrects its July 2026 escrow release announcement. Shareholders should monitor for any further corrections or clarifications regarding these funds.

announcements.headline: Release of Monies from Escrow in Cyprus
announcements.insight: Monies release follows the June land sale. This completes the transaction cycle initiated earlier in the year.

announcements.headline: Review of Directors Independence
announcements.insight: DCI Advisors Ltd reviews director independence following its AGM results and land sale. Shareholders should monitor for any resulting board composition changes.

announcements.headline: Apollo land plots sale completed
announcements.insight: DCI Advisors Ltd has completed the sale of land plots. This follows the recent AGM results, indicating a progression in asset management activities.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: The AGM results were announced in May 2026. Shareholders should monitor future filings for any strategic updates or governance changes.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the outcome of the Annual General Meeting. This result reflects standard governance procedures without indicating immediate strategic shifts.
